verdict.rationale: A state business and lien filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or background automations, such as auto-renewals or recurring filings, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only manual, login-gated filing, search and ordering surfaces. The 'Data and Image Subscriptions' and 'Farm Product Monthly Subscription' items are recurring data products, not user-configurable autonomous automations, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
